soil_health.title: Soil Health Assessment
soil_health.follow_steps: Follow these simple steps to assess your soil health

ph_testing.title: Soil pH Testing
ph_testing.description: Use a pH strip or digital meter. Mix 1 part soil with 1 part clean water, wait 30 minutes, then test. Ideal range: 6.0-7.5 for most crops.

moisture_check.title: Soil Moisture Check
moisture_check.description: Squeeze test: Dry = crumbles apart, Medium = holds shape but crumbles when poked, Wet = water drips out when squeezed.

organic_assessment.title: Organic Matter Assessment
organic_assessment.description: Check soil color: Good = dark brown/black with visible organic bits, Moderate = medium brown, Poor = light brown/sandy color.

soil_health.use_instructions: Use the instructions above to fill in these values
soil_health.squeeze_test: Choose based on squeeze test results
soil_health.soil_color: Based on soil color and visible organic matter
soil_health.pro_tip: Pro Tip: Test your soil 2-3 times per year (before planting seasons) for best results. For detailed nutrient analysis, contact your local agricultural extension office.

recommendations.healthy: Soil is healthy. Maintain current practices.
recommendations.moderate: Soil health is moderate. Consider irrigation adjustment and adding organic matter.
recommendations.poor: Soil health is poor. Add compost/organic matter, adjust irrigation, and correct pH.
